depiction.primary_object: outlined cloud shape with flat bottom
depiction.composition: single outlined object with internal checkmark glyph

readings.meaning: cloud backup, synced files, or cloud storage
verify cloud sync or completed upload
cloud computing service or online account setup

ambiguity: Could be confused with a plain weather cloud icon at very small sizes if the checkmark blurs into the outline, or with a cloud-upload arrow icon.

modifier_semantics.meaning: synced, backed up, verified, completed, or saved to cloud

task_intents: back up files to cloud storage

reasoning: A cloud with a checkmark inside is the universal UI glyph for cloud sync completed, cloud backup, or saved to cloud storage. It fits a common, concrete family of personal and work tasks around backing up devices, syncing folders (iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Backblaze), and verifying off-site backups. It is distinct from weather clouds because of the checkmark, though it sits close to cloud-upload and cloud-download icons.
